plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/SKILL..why: Adds the Platform Adaptation section, whose runtime sentence the generator stamps from RUNTIMES, with its task-tool and todo.md fallback (per task slug when sessions share a checkout, and beside the desktop app's short update_plan list), keeps a skipped playbook step in the todolist as a skip line, the deploy-platform and defect-severity triggers, the focused-fix exception to the architect trigger, the port's principle summaries, the project playbooks paragraph, and the closed-review-gate rule that the Codex and Pi mappings point to, and it uses the namespaced pstack:poteto-agent name, requires stopping an abandoned agent before replacing it, renders every reply item as prose, layers technical-writing on top of unslop, points the bot-review trigger at the triage rubric, and lets a level above xhigh that the sheet sets for a role stand, since the port's setup offers max where upstream's budget step capped at xhigh, and routes a new project or an unclear large feature to potluck's grill skill while the user is present, or to the floor and a ketchup list of questions when nobody is, and attaches a statechart to the reply when a change touches a feature's state logic and TLC is already installed, proposing the run and what it would install otherwise, ticks a feature's Done when item with its proof, regenerating the overview, when a change meets it, routes handoff requests in any language to Pause safely, its checkpoint mode, or Session pickup, and names what routes to domain-modeling and constraint-driven-development and what skips grill, and has the first message in a repository run gates.mjs and follow the operator's gates it prints, which only the user changes: an agent never edits a gates file and suggests changes instead.
plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/SKILL..ruling: Use all of Michael's front-door additions (group S3-E), including the focused-fix exception (S3-B4). Route new projects and unclear large features to grill, and skip it when nobody is present (S4-G1, S4-G8). Attach a statechart unasked when a change touches a feature's state logic, and give one whenever asked (S4-R5); since 2026-11-26 only when TLC is already installed, and otherwise propose the run and say what it would install, because the first run downloads TLC and Java (the owner, 2026-11-26). Progress is a Done when checkbox ticked only with its proof, and the overview is regenerated with it (S4-R2). Stage 5 issue 11: handoff requests route in Chinese as well as English, and a request to save progress that does not ask to stop goes to the checkpoint-and-keep-going mode (S3-D2, S3-D3). Name in poteto-mode what routes to domain-modeling, constraint-driven-development, and grill, then measure with eval layer 2 (S4-G1, stage 5 issue 14). The operator's gates, stricter settings than these defaults from a per-user and a per-repository file with the stricter value winning, are read at the start of a run, and only the user changes them: an agent, the root agent included, follows them and may suggest a change, and the file's git history is the record (stage 5, operator's gates, as corrected by the stage 5 follow-up answers, issue 2; S3-A1).
plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/SKILL..ruling_zh: 采用 Michael 加在前台的全部规则（S3-E 组），包括聚焦修复的例外（S3-B4）。新项目和意图不清的大功能先走 grill，没人在场时跳过（S4-G1、S4-G8）。改动涉及功能的状态逻辑时主动附上状态图，用户要时随时给（S4-R5）；2026-11-26 起只在已经装好 TLC 时主动跑，否则先提议，并说明要装什么，因为第一次运行会从网上下载 TLC 和 Java。进度以带证据勾选的完成条件为准，同时重新生成总览（S4-R2）。阶段 5 第 11 条：交接相关的请求用中文说也能分派，要求存档但没说停下的，走存完接着做的模式（S3-D2、S3-D3）。在 poteto-mode 里写明什么情况走 domain-modeling、constraint-driven-development 和 grill，再用 eval 第 2 层量（S4-G1，阶段 5 第 14 条）。操作者的门是比这些默认更严的设置，来自个人和仓库两份文件，取更严的那个；开局时读取，只有用户自己能改：agent（包括 root agent）只能遵守、可以提建议，改动记录就是文件的 git 历史（阶段 5 操作者的门，按追加答复第 2 条更正；S3-A1）。

plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/playbo.why: Each owner merges its verified PR itself with gh pr merge --squash --match-head-commit --author-email once a verifier's potluck/verdict status on the exact head and every check, the CI quality floor's included, are green, never with --auto, and reads the merge back; the root co-signs a changed or moved assertion in a PR comment that names the head and the floor's fingerprint, then reruns the floor job; the root writes the program objective into the store's notes.md on the go and re-reads it each tick, arms the tick as a dynamic-mode /loop, states the program's size before the first owner starts without waiting on it, scopes review lanes to what the diff breaks, and after two fix-forwards picks a fresh owner, a split, or a parked draft itself, and has the owner rebase its own branch on a conflict-free rebase or behind-base, sending a conflict or a refused lease to the root, and names the operator's gates file as the source of standing operator gates, with a PR that has no CI result under noCI wait as one reached.
plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/playbo.ruling: The lead agent merges on a clean verdict with no human step, as in Lauren's design (S3-A1). Keep Michael's notes.md objective, diff-scoped review, and dynamic loop (S3-A2, S3-A4, S3-A5). State the program's size but do not wait for a go above three owners (S3-A3). Keep two fix rounds per PR, then the root agent retries with a fresh approach, splits the PR, or parks it as a draft, without waiting (S3-A6). Babysit keeps reporting conflicts and behind-base, and the owner rebases a conflict-free branch itself, reporting only a conflict or a push that would need force beyond its lease (S3-C4). The operator's gates of step 1 become a formal file, per user and per repository, the stricter value winning, read by a hook and by poteto-mode at the start (stage 5, operator's gates). 2026-11-25: merge the way Lauren's and Michael's playbooks do, with gh pr merge --match-head-commit after a passing verdict instead of potluck's merge gate script; the verdict stays a potluck/verdict commit status, which the repository ruleset requires, and the root's co-sign of a changed assertion becomes a PR comment, as in Lauren's step 6.
plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/playbo.ruling_zh: 按 Lauren 的设计，主 agent 在结论干净时直接合并，不经人工（S3-A1）。保留 Michael 的 notes.md 目标、只看 diff 的审查和动态循环（S3-A2、S3-A4、S3-A5）。说明整个程序的规模，但超过三个负责人也不等人放行（S3-A3）。每个 PR 最多修两轮，之后由 root agent 换思路重试、拆分 PR 或改成草稿搁置，不等人（S3-A6）。Babysit 继续报告冲突和落后于基线，没有冲突的分支由负责人自己 rebase，只报告冲突或超出 lease 的强推（S3-C4）。第 1 步说的操作者的门做成正式的配置文件，个人和仓库各一份，取更严的那个，由钩子和 poteto-mode 开局读取（阶段 5，操作者的门）。2026-11-25：照 Lauren 和 Michael 的 playbook 合并，结论通过后用 gh pr merge --match-head-commit，不再用 potluck 的合并门脚本；结论仍是 potluck/verdict 提交状态，仓库规则集要求它；root 对改了的断言的会签改成 PR 评论，同 Lauren 的第 6 步。

plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/playbo.why: Records each verdict's head SHA, base SHA, base branch, and patch-id, cancels pending merges and leases each push against the captured remote head before any restack, and re-verifies a verdict whose applicability to the new base is uncertain.
plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/playbo.ruling: Use Michael's verdict records and leased restacks (S3-A7).
plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/playbo.ruling_zh: 采用 Michael 的结论记录和带 lease 的重新堆叠（S3-A7）。

plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/playbo.why: Requires confirming that the first status read reports the requested PR or stack, and naming the merge frontier, before acting on it, and reports the watcher's behind-base gate to the branch owner instead of resolving it, as it does a conflict. In a Claude Code cloud session, which refuses GraphQL, the watcher now reads the PR over REST on its own; points at the REST reads in `cloud-session-pr-reads.md` only for what the watcher does not report.
plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/playbo.ruling: Babysit reports conflicts and behind-base to the owner; in autopilot the owner rebases a conflict-free branch itself, as in Lauren's design, and reports only conflicts or force pushes. Keep Michael's first-read confirmation (S3-C4).
plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/playbo.ruling_zh: Babysit 把冲突和落后于基线报告给负责人；在 autopilot 里，没有冲突的分支按 Lauren 的设计由负责人自己 rebase，只报告冲突或强推。保留 Michael 的首读确认（S3-C4）。

plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/playbo.why: Quotes decisive failing and passing output trimmed to the assertion and counts, separates verified code, publication, observed runtime behavior, and blockers, selects non-sensitive diagnostic fields before printing, and adds a focused-fix exception with explicit architecture and independent correctness review triggers for higher-risk fixes.
plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/playbo.ruling: Use Michael's evidence rules and his focused-fix exception as written; it came from user feedback that small fixes triggered a full design pass (S3-B3, S3-B4).
plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/playbo.ruling_zh: 照原样采用 Michael 的证据规则和聚焦修复例外；它来自用户反馈：小修复会触发完整的设计流程（S3-B3、S3-B4）。

plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/playbo.ruling: Use Michael's one worktree per writing delegate (S3-C1).
plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/playbo.ruling_zh: 采用 Michael 的规则：每个写代码的委派 agent 用一个独立 worktree（S3-C1）。

plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/playbo.ruling_zh: 所有技术适配都照 Michael 的做法保留（S3-H 组）。

plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/playbo.ruling: Use Michael's rule to stop live agents before committing (S3-C2).
plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/playbo.ruling_zh: 采用 Michael 的规则：提交前先停掉还在跑的 agent（S3-C2）。

plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/playbo.why: Writes the resume note to a checkpoint directory for the task's folder and task, in Git or not, preserves artifacts the user asked to keep across the resume, and adds a checkpoint-and-keep-going mode for a handoff request that does not ask to stop.
plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/playbo.ruling: Use Michael's resume.mjs, which writes a checkpoint in a fixed form (S3-D1), and his checkpoint location and kept artifacts (S3-D2). Stage 5 issue 11 changed resume.mjs, which has no entry of its own because it is not an upstream file: one checkpoint pointer per folder and task, so projects in one repository or vault stop overwriting each other, and folders outside Git get checkpoints too, and each pause records HEAD. A checkpoint the user asks for without asking to stop is not a pause, and the session keeps going.
plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/playbo.ruling_zh: 采用 Michael 用 resume.mjs 写固定格式检查点的做法（S3-D1），以及他的检查点位置和保留的产物（S3-D2）。阶段 5 第 11 条改了 resume.mjs（它不是上游文件，所以没有自己的登记）：每个文件夹加任务各有一个检查点指针，一个仓库或 vault 里的几个项目不会再覆盖彼此的指针；Git 之外的文件夹也能存检查点，每次暂停记录 HEAD。用户要求存档但没说停下时，存完检查点继续做，这不算暂停。

plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/playbo.why: Reads the checkpoint for the task's folder and task first, lists the store before any transcript fallback, rechecks the note against commits that landed after the recorded head, applies the human-rulings epistemics when reconstructing state, and verifies inherited claims before it routes and ends.
plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/playbo.ruling: Use Michael's checkpoint-first pickup and human-rulings priority (S3-D3, S3-D4, S3-D5). Stage 5 issue 11: a pause records HEAD, and pickup compares it first and rechecks the note when it moved, which is Lauren's verify-inherited-claims step.
plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/playbo.ruling_zh: 采用 Michael 先读检查点的接手方式，以及人的裁定优先（S3-D3、S3-D4、S3-D5）。阶段 5 第 11 条：暂停时记录 HEAD；接手时先比较，HEAD 变了就先重新核对说明里的结论，这就是 Lauren 核对继承结论的那一步。

plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/playbo.why: Lands one PR at a time under the user's landing authority, cancelling pending merges before any chain change, recording each verifier's result as a potluck/verdict commit status with gh api and merging with gh pr merge --squash --match-head-commit --author-email once that status and every check are green, never --auto, running floor.mjs first where CI does not run the floor, and confirming each landing in the destination's history before advancing, with verifiers that drive the real surface through the driver skill in their own worktrees, a matching patch-id that keeps a review only after its applicability to the new base is checked, and the watcher owning blocker classification, with a branch behind its base routed to the topology owner, and merges a PR with no checks at all on its verdict unless the operator's gates say noCI wait, which leaves it merge-ready for a person. Stops at merge-ready when GitHub refuses GraphQL, as in a Claude Code cloud session, because ship-pr and merging still need GraphQL there; the watcher itself now reports PR status in that session over REST, and the always-ask list points at the REST reads in `cloud-session-pr-reads.md` for what it does not report.
plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/playbo.ruling: Merge on a verdict commit status, green CI, and the quality floor, with --match-head-commit, without --auto or waiting for a human (S3-A8); since 2026-11-25 with Michael's gh pr merge --match-head-commit command instead of potluck's merge gate script, the floor running in CI. Use Michael's one-at-a-time landing and verifier rules (S3-A9, S3-A10). A conflict-free rebase is the owner's own job; only conflicts or force pushes are reported (S3-C4). A PR with no checks is told apart from failed checks and merges on its verdict like a repository with no CI; the operator's gates can make either wait for a person (stage 5 issues 4 and 16).
plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/playbo.ruling_zh: 凭 verdict 提交状态、CI 通过和质量底线合并，用 --match-head-commit，不用 --auto，也不等人（S3-A8）；2026-11-25 起改用 Michael 的 gh pr merge --match-head-commit 命令，不再用 potluck 的合并门脚本，底线放进 CI。采用 Michael 的一次落一个和验证者规则（S3-A9、S3-A10）。没有冲突的 rebase 由负责人自己做，只报告冲突或强推（S3-C4）。PR 上没有任何检查和检查失败分开处理：没有检查的按没有 CI 处理，凭 verdict 合并；操作者的门可以改成等人合并（阶段 5 第 4、16 条）。

plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/playbo.why: Holds a worktree with untracked files or a git lock instead of calling untracked files safe to drop, names the untracked count and the lock reason the audit prints, says that a worktree with both tracked edits and untracked files prints both counts, names the status call the audit counts from and a diff command that covers submodules, says that an empty diff never means nothing is at stake because a diff leaves untracked files out and a plain one can leave a submodule out, says that a wip line can stand for work inside a submodule, limits the prune step's kept-commits claim to commits on the worktree's branch and says a submodule's commits go with the worktree, holds ignored files outside the audit's disposable build and cache directories and commits only the worktree's HEAD reflog reaches, naming the ignored and reflog counts and the commands that list them, including ignored paths in initialized submodules, and forbids rm -rf around a locked tree; then, instead of pausing for a decision (the list-it step now ends by backing it up), runs potluck's worktree-backup.mjs on every worktree before removal, clean ones included (a local backup branch, a trash tarball kept 30 days that also holds the raw copy of each changed or filtered tracked file, and branches for HEAD-only commits), and deletes it without asking only through potluck's worktree-remove.mjs, which refuses any path but the top level of a linked worktree git lists, checks the backup branches and the tarball against the worktree, and moves the worktree to the trash instead of deleting it (the prune step forbids rm -rf and git worktree remove --force), skipping and reporting a hold (a backup that does not match the worktree; locked trees; any initialized submodule, files in an uninitialized one's folder, or a submodule repository in the worktree's git dir; an operation in progress; skip-worktree or assume-unchanged files on disk; unmerged paths or no commit yet), a failed run, and in-use trees; and its reclaimers step never deletes conversation transcripts, pointing at caches and the user's trash folder instead.
plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/playbo.ruling: Use Michael's risk checks, then back up automatically and let the agent delete without asking: uncommitted work to a wip commit on a backup branch, untracked and ignored files to a trash directory kept 30 days, HEAD-only commits to a branch; skip and report worktrees another agent holds (S3-C3). Stage 5 issue 6 keeps that and adds three safeguards: the backup is checked before anything is deleted, and a mismatch holds the worktree and is reported; the worktree moves to the trash and is cleared after the retention period, never rm -rf; only the top level of a linked worktree may be touched, and any other path is an error (S3-C3). The owner 2026-11-26: never delete conversation transcripts to free disk.
plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/playbo.ruling_zh: 采用 Michael 的风险检查，然后自动备份并让 agent 不问就删除：未提交的改动做成备份分支上的 wip 提交，未跟踪和被忽略的文件放进保留 30 天的回收目录，只在 HEAD 上的提交存成分支；别的 agent 占用的 worktree 跳过并报告（S3-C3）。阶段 5 第 6 条保留这一做法，再加三道保险：删之前核对备份，核对不过就不删，并写进汇报；worktree 移到回收目录，过了保留期再清，不直接 rm -rf；只允许操作已登记的 worktree 根目录，别的路径一律报错（S3-C3）。2026-11-26 负责人定：不为腾出磁盘空间删除对话记录。

plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/script.ruling_zh: 所有技术适配都照 Michael 的做法保留（S3-H 组）。

plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/script.ruling_zh: 所有技术适配都照 Michael 的做法保留（S3-H 组）。

plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/script.why: Supplies the shared deadline and landing revision the port's watcher requires, and checks that a PR with no checks configured gets a first-sighting status cell and, after one WAITING poll, a READY verdict that names the absence, and that mergeability GitHub has not computed is named in the status table, the WAITING line, and the TIMEOUT line, that a retry after a mid-read change is not called a failed query, that a command that could not run gets an install action, that an --interval longer than one timer can sleep is refused, and the two help lines the port rewrote.
plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/script.ruling: Keep every technical adaptation as Michael made it (group S3-H).
plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/script.ruling_zh: 所有技术适配都照 Michael 的做法保留（S3-H 组）。

plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/script.why: Threads one WatchDeadline through discovery, commands, and polling, reports a deadline verdict instead of throwing, rejects an --interval longer than one timer can sleep, and says in its help that --interval does not shorten the 60 second no-checks confirmation and that exit 0 from --status-only does not mean ready. Adds the repeatable --expect-app option, checked as a GitHub App slug, which names the apps whose queued suite with no runs counts as pending. Reads through FallbackGitHubReader, which switches to the cloud-session REST reader at the first GraphQL refusal.
plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/script.ruling: Keep every technical adaptation as Michael made it (group S3-H).
plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/script.ruling_zh: 所有技术适配都照 Michael 的做法保留（S3-H 组）。

plugins/pstack/skills/constraint-driven-.why: Fixes three faults the first pilot hit, then follows stage 5 issues 1, 2, 3, 7 and 17. The suppression, stub, skip, and test checks read every file that runs and leave only plain `.md` unchecked, while CONSTRAINTS.md's exception and rule checks always run; a repository's first CONSTRAINTS.md may carry exception rows, so the skill's own template passes as written. A bullet's key ends at either colon, unambiguous Chinese bar words can only add threshold findings to main's English reading (a 至少 flipped to 至多, or a bar stripped of its word), rule names in a CONSTRAINTS.md the change touches must be unique, and each removed rule pairs with its own counterpart, same form first. Swift `*Tests.swift` files, XCTSkip, and XCTAssert count as tests, and a test step removed or commented out of CI configuration is reported. A test file renamed with its blob unchanged, within its folder, keeping its extension under a plain name that changes no listed runner's default discovery (and, for Go, a name go test reads), with no snapshot keyed by its old name, is dropped from the diff by name, so it passes when only renamed; every other path is diffed as main's gate diffs it, so a test renamed with edits or moved elsewhere, or any file renamed out of what the guard checks, still reads as removed. An assertion moved within its file, or replaced by a new one, is reported as moved or changed rather than removed, for the floor to pass once the root agent co-signs it.
plugins/pstack/skills/constraint-driven-.ruling: Borrowed Addy's Floor as a script inside the merge gate (S4-D5, S3-A8); since 2026-11-25 it runs as its own CI job on every pull request. Stage 5 then fixed bugs in it. First, fix the three floor-guard faults the first pilot found (the skill's own template refused, full-width colons, shared rule keys) as bugs. Then, stage 5 issue 1: look for the forbidden forms in every file that runs (code, .mdx, notebook code, CI configuration) and skip only plain .md; always run the bar checks on CONSTRAINTS.md; widening the skip list loosens a check and needs the root agent's co-sign and a register entry; CI carries two canaries that must both hold, the template as written passes and a code file with a deliberate suppression is stopped. Issue 2: rule names split on either colon, with Chinese tests. Issue 3: a duplicate rule name is an error. Issue 7: recognize Swift test files and XCTSkip, and report a test step removed from CI, with canaries. Issue 17: a test file that was only renamed passes, found by git's rename detection; a changed assertion value goes to the root agent, which checks the verifier's evidence that the behavior changed and co-signs without waiting for a person, and the co-sign goes into a decision log; since 2026-11-25 the co-sign is the root agent's PR comment naming the head and the findings' fingerprint.
